== Notes ==
* The caster must have at least 2 [[health]] in order to successfully resurrect the target.
* The health loss occurs before the resurrection.

== Trivia ==
* The skill's name references [[w:Book of Genesis|Genesis]] [https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Genesis%202%3A18-24&version=NIV 2:23]. After [[w:Adam|Adam]] failed to find a partner among the other creatures of the earth, God puts him to sleep to take one of his rib bones and use it to create Eve. Upon waking up and meeting Eve, Adam is finally content and says ''"“ this is now bone of my bones, and '''flesh of my flesh''': she shall be called ‘Woman,’ because she was taken out of ‘Man.’”"''
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
